provenance.paper_title: Towards Unified World Models for Visual Navigation via Memory-Augmented Planning and Foresight

representation_paths.memory_component: Intra-step memory bank for short-term perceptual grounding

evidence.paraphrase: The autoregressive backbone writes visual-planning context into hierarchical memory.; Intra-step memory stores local perceptual cues during rollout generation.; Cross-step memory carries trajectory context across extended horizons.. memory-augmented planning reads intra-/cross-step banks to align imagined future states.

representation_paths.memory_component: Cross-step memory bank for longer trajectory context

evidence.paraphrase: The autoregressive backbone writes visual-planning context into hierarchical memory.; Intra-step memory stores local perceptual cues during rollout generation.; Cross-step memory carries trajectory context across extended horizons.. memory-augmented planning reads intra-/cross-step banks to align imagined future states.

During operation, UniWM applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to Intra-step memory bank for short-term perceptual grounding; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (Intra-step memory bank for short-term perceptual grounding) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
